name: Quicker – WooCommerce Quick Checkout, Checkout Field Editor & Order Bumps
author: Wpbens

sections.description:
Quicker is the all-in-one WooCommerce quick checkout plugin that lets you add and edit checkout fields, enable multi-step or fast checkout, display order bumps, add a mini cart, charge conditional fees, and much more — all without writing a single line of code.

Whether you want to speed up your WooCommerce checkout, customize checkout fields, skip the cart page, or show upsell offers at checkout, Quicker handles it all in one plugin.

Used by WooCommerce stores worldwide to reduce cart abandonment and increase conversions.

✅ What You Can Do With Quicker

  • Add custom checkout fields — use the visual checkout field editor to add, remove, reorder, and conditionally show/hide fields at WooCommerce checkout
  • Enable WooCommerce fast checkout — single-step or multi-step checkout flow to reduce friction at the payment screen
  • Skip the cart page — send customers directly from product page to WooCommerce checkout with one click
  • Add order bumps and upsells — display targeted product offers at checkout to increase average order value
  • WooCommerce mini cart — add a sticky floating cart icon so shoppers never lose track of their items
  • Charge extra fees — add COD charges, service fees, or delivery fees based on payment method, shipping method, product, cart total, or user role
  • AJAX add-to-cart — let customers add simple and variable products without reloading the page
  • WooCommerce quick view — show a product popup on shop and archive pages so shoppers can preview details without leaving
  • Min/max order amount and quantity — enforce order limits that match your business rules
  • Product addons — offer upgrades and add-on options on product pages or at checkout

🔑 FEATURE DETAILS

WooCommerce Checkout Field Editor
Drag, drop, and configure checkout fields without code. Add text fields, dropdowns, checkboxes, date pickers, and more. Show or hide fields conditionally — based on product, category, user role, or cart contents. Works with every WooCommerce theme.

WooCommerce Fast Checkout (Single-Step & Multi-Step)
Offer a streamlined single-step checkout for speed, or a multi-step checkout for stores with complex forms. Multi-step checkout breaks the process into stages (contact → shipping → payment) to reduce overwhelm and drop-off.

WooCommerce Direct Checkout — Skip the Cart
Enable one-click direct checkout from product pages, shop pages, archive pages, or specific product categories. Customers go straight to checkout — no cart detour. Proven to reduce cart abandonment.

Order Bumps & Checkout Upsells
Show a product offer directly on the checkout page. Customers add it in one click without leaving the form. Order bumps are the highest-converting upsell method in WooCommerce — no extra page, no extra friction.

WooCommerce Mini Cart
Add a floating mini cart icon to every page. Customers can review, update quantities, remove items, and proceed to checkout without interrupting their browsing. Multiple icon styles and fully customizable.

Extra Fees Including COD Charges
Charge conditional extra fees based on: payment method (COD surcharge), shipping method, specific products or categories, user role, cart total, or cart quantity. Service fee, handling fee, COD charge — all covered.

WooCommerce Quick View Popup
Display a Quick View button on WooCommerce shop and archive pages. Clicking it opens a product popup with images, description, price, and an add-to-cart button. Keeps shoppers on the page longer and speeds up the path to purchase.

AJAX Add-to-Cart for Simple and Variable Products
No page reload needed. Customers add products to the WooCommerce cart instantly. Works for simple products and variable products (with attribute selection).

Min/Max Order Amount and Quantity
Set minimum or maximum order amount thresholds. Set min/max quantity limits per product or category. Customers see a clear notice when their cart doesn’t qualify.

💡 WHO IS QUICKER FOR?

Quicker is ideal for:

  • WooCommerce store owners who want a faster, higher-converting checkout
  • Stores that need custom checkout fields for delivery notes, business details, or gift messages
  • eCommerce businesses that want to add order bumps and upsells without a funnel builder
  • Store managers who want a mini cart and quick view without a page builder
  • Any WooCommerce site looking to reduce cart abandonment and increase revenue

🔥 ALSO FROM THE SAME TEAM

🔔 MemberHub – Membership and loyalty features for WooCommerce
🔔 Filter Plus – Advanced product filter with price range, ratings, tags, and custom fields
🔔 Discountify – Discount rules, BOGO deals, and dynamic pricing for WooCommerce
🔔 Bens Email Marketing & Automation – Email marketing, newsletters, automation, and CRM for WordPress
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/quicker directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. All settings are found in the WordPress admin sidebar under Quicker.
sections.faq:
How do I add custom checkout fields in WooCommerce?

Install Quicker, then go to Quicker → Checkout Fields in your WordPress admin. Use the drag-and-drop field editor to add, remove, reorder, and conditionally show/hide fields. You can add text inputs, dropdowns, checkboxes, date pickers, and more — no code needed. Fields can be shown or hidden based on product, category, cart value, or user role.

How do I enable WooCommerce quick checkout?

Go to Quicker → Settings and enable Direct Checkout. This sends customers from the product page directly to the WooCommerce checkout page, skipping the cart. You can also enable single-step checkout for a faster payment experience.

Can I skip the WooCommerce cart page?

Yes. Quicker’s Direct Checkout feature lets customers go from product page to checkout in one click — bypassing the cart entirely. You can enable it for the shop page, archive pages, and specific product categories or individual products.

How do I set up WooCommerce multi-step checkout?

Go to Quicker → Checkout and enable Multi-Step Checkout. Quicker will break the checkout form into stages — contact details, shipping, and payment. Each step is displayed one at a time, reducing form overwhelm and improving completion rates.

How do I add an order bump or upsell at checkout?

Go to Quicker → Order Bumps and create a new offer. Select the product to offer, write a short headline, and choose where it appears. The offer shows as a checkbox or button on the checkout page — customers add it in one click without leaving the form.

How do I add a mini cart to my WooCommerce store?

Go to Quicker → Mini Cart and enable it. Choose an icon style and position. The floating mini cart icon appears on every page — clicking it slides open a cart preview where customers can update quantities, remove items, and go to checkout.

How do I charge a COD fee or extra fee at WooCommerce checkout?

Go to Quicker → Extra Fees and create a new fee. Set the condition to “Payment Method = Cash on Delivery” to add a COD surcharge automatically. You can also charge fees based on shipping method, product, product category, user role, cart total, or cart quantity.

How do I add a WooCommerce quick view popup?

Go to Quicker → Quick View and enable it. A Quick View button will appear on your WooCommerce shop and archive pages. Clicking it opens a product popup with the image, description, price, and add-to-cart button — without navigating away from the page.

How do I enable one-click checkout or instant checkout in WooCommerce?

Enable Direct Checkout in Quicker → Settings. This adds a “Buy Now” or “Checkout” button on the product page that takes the customer straight to checkout in one click. You can also enable AJAX add-to-cart for a no-reload shopping experience.

Does Quicker support AJAX add-to-cart for variable products?

Yes. Quicker enables AJAX add-to-cart for both simple and variable WooCommerce products. Customers select attributes and add products to the cart instantly — no page reload. Enable it in Quicker → Settings.

Can I set a minimum or maximum order amount in WooCommerce?

Yes. Go to Quicker → Min/Max Order Amount and set your threshold. Customers will see a notice at the cart or checkout page if their order value does not meet the minimum or exceeds the maximum. You can also set min/max quantity limits per product.

Is Quicker compatible with my WooCommerce theme?

Quicker is built on standard WooCommerce hooks and is fully responsive — it works on desktop, tablet, and mobile. It is compatible with most WooCommerce themes including Storefront, Astra, Flatsome, OceanWP, and Kadence. Custom themes may need minor CSS adjustments.

Can I add product addons or upgrades at checkout?

Yes. Quicker supports product addons — extra options or upgrades that customers can select on the product page or at checkout. Use this for gift wrapping, extended warranties, personalization, or any paid upgrade.

Does Quicker work with Discountify?

Yes. Quicker is built by the same team as Discountify and includes native compatibility — including Discountify discount labels displayed correctly inside the Quicker mini cart.

Do you have dedicated support?

Yes. Our dedicated support team is available to help with setup, configuration, and any issues you run into.
